newsitem.title: FRANCE: ONIC sees 3.4 pct rise in 97 grain sowings.
newsitem.headline: ONIC sees 3.4 pct rise in 97 grain sowings.

text.p: French cereals office ONIC said on Wednesday it estimated total grain sowings for the 1997 harvest at 8.992 million hectares, up 3.4 percent from 1996.

The estimate is the first published by the agency for all grains including maize, with the forecast for that type of cereal in line with industry estimates at 1.73 million hectares, up 0.8 percent from last year.
ONIC retains its wheat area estimate at 4.95 million hectares but revised up its winter barley estimate to 1.6 million hectares from a previous estimate of 1.12 million hectares.
It said the soft wheat area had risen 4.1 percent since last year and the winter barley area had risen five percent.
